assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 reverts the earlier change that split arrays in YAML to fix ambiguous collapse when array items have nested objects (#21064), so that array-splitting behavior is no longer present.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: the note names no setting, field, flag, endpoint or view and states no condition under which an environment is affected; any exposure would depend on runtime rendering of YAML arrays whose items have nested objects, which no static input carries; consequence: the note records only that the change is reverted; it does not state what an upgrading environment experiences or whether the reverted behavior shipped in any prior release
